Exchange/platform: BYDFi
Headline: BYDFi Buy Crypto Year-End Perks: 3% Cashback + Up to 1,100 USDT in BTC Airdrop Positions!
Prize pool: 1,100 USDT
Start: 2026-11-26T12:00:00Z · End: 2026-12-16T12:00:00Z
Smallest threshold (parsed): 100 USDT (buy)
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Dear BYDFi Users,
Unlock extra rewards this year-end! Complete an eligible first crypto purchase to receive 3% cashback and a 100 USDT BTC Airdrop Position. Reach cumulative purchase targets during the event to unlock up to 1,000 USDT in additional BTC Airdrop Positions. Rewards from both offers can be combined!
📅 Event Period: 2026/11/26 20:00 – 2026/12/16 20:00（UTC+8）
👉 Join Now
🎁 Offer 1: First Crypto Purchase, Double Rewards
Make your first successful crypto purchase of over 50 USDT to receive:
A 100 USDT BTC Airdrop Position
3% cashback: Calculated based on your first successful purchase order, capped at 200 USDT and paid in USDT.
Both rewards can be claimed together. This offer has a 50,000 USDT prize pool, available on a first-come, first-served basis while supplies last!
🪙 Offer 2: Buy More Crypto, Unlock Tiered Rewards
Open to all users! Reach the following cumulative crypto purchase targets during the event to claim the corresponding BTC Airdrop Position rewards:
Cumulative Crypto Purchases | BTC Airdrop Position Rewards
≥ 100 USDT | 100 USDT
≥ 300 USDT | 250 USDT
≥ 500 USDT | 500 USDT
≥ 1,000 USDT | 1,000 USDT
Earn up to 1,100 USDT in BTC Airdrop Positions across both offers, plus 3% cashback on your first crypto purchase!
## Notes:
1. First-purchase rewards apply to your first successful crypto purchase order, which must exceed 50 USDT.
2. Only successful crypto purchases completed during the event count toward cumulative purchase targets.
3. Please refer to the event page for BTC Airdrop Position usage conditions, tier reward claim procedures, and distribution rules.

Exchange/platform: Binance
Headline: Binance Blockchain Week: Share Your Experience and Celebrate Your Community Hero to Share 1,000 USDC!
Prize pool: 1,000 USDC
Start: 2026-11-28T01:00:00Z · End: 2026-11-30T23:59:00Z
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Fellow Binancians,
Binance Blockchain Week Bangkok is here, and the celebration extends to our global community - whether you're on the ground in Bangkok or joining from anywhere in the world.
Two new challenges are live: show us your Blockchain Week moment, and honor the Community Heroes who make Binance what it is.
Complete one or both challenges for a chance to share a total prize pool of 1,000 USDC in token vouchers.
Activity Period: 2026-11-28 01:00 (UTC) to 2026-11-30 23:59 (UTC)
## How to Participate
## Challenge 1: Share Your Binance Blockchain Week Experience
Step 1: Take a real picture at the event, or create an AI-generated photo of yourself at the Binance Blockchain Week experience.
Step 2: Make a post on X with the picture and the 3 most memorable quotes from the event.
Step 3: Add the hashtag #BinanceBlockchainWeek to your post.
Step 4: Share your post in this Binance Survey.
Binance will select the best 25 posts at its sole discretion. Winners of these 25 posts will share a prize pool of 500 USDC in token vouchers.
## Challenge 2: Find Your Binance Community Hero
Step 1: Find a Binance Community Hero at the event and take a picture with him. You can find them in the activities areas with a special T-shirt.
Step 2: Make a post on X answering the question: "Why Binance community is always at the forefront of the market".
